name: Irving
housing: Irving has a large share of renters, many in big apartment complexes around Las Colinas and Valley Ranch near the office districts and DFW Airport.

climate: Test the air conditioning and check windows and the roof for hail damage; North Texas summers are hot and storms bring hail.
fact: Las Colinas was built as a planned business district, and much of its housing is apartments for people working nearby.
